description: This source file defines constants for known Git object IDs and implements hashing functions for SHA-1 and SHA-256 algorithms, including context initialization, cloning, updating, finalizing, and algorithm lookup functions. It also includes definitions for null, empty, and default OIDs corresponding to different hash algorithms.

methods.description: Initializes a SHA-1 hash context.

methods.description: Clones a SHA-1 hash context.

methods.description: Updates the SHA-1 hash context with data.

methods.description: Finalizes the SHA-1 hash and outputs the digest.

methods.description: Finalizes the SHA-1 hash, outputs the digest as object_id, and zero-pads the result.
